senses.definition: An official government car, especially a Comcar.
senses.example: It was hot, which did nothing for the collective irritability, until Senator Chaney turned up and suggested we use his chauffeur-driven Z car — blissfully air-conditioned.

senses.definition: The larger chromosome that has more genes, in the ZW system.
The number of standard deviation units away from the mean a particular value of data lies.
A length of steel or aluminium with a Z-shaped cross-section.
senses.example: The car body is a light steel shell fabricated by welding from top-hat, channel, and Z sections.

senses.definition: The Z-shaped twist of yarn spun in a clockwise direction.
